$comment: Answer the Gallery panel's four /api/gallery endpoints from files committed under <scope>gallery/, so the panel is usable on a static deploy. Shipped empty: the panel renders gallery cards INSTEAD of the built-in example list, so any default content would either hide the instructor-unlock flow or bypass it.
$how: node scripts/patch-outbound.mjs --manifest=scripts/gallery-shim.json   (then: npm run bump:shellcache if check 13 says so)
$shape: Both repairs are insertions, so each declares a marker instead of relying on anchor consumption. regen: node analysis/_tmp/_m10/gen-gallery-shim.mjs

repairs.why: the four endpoint handlers, the index reader and the id guard. Kept out of the fetch listener so the routing change below is one line of dispatch rather than a block of logic.

route /api/gallery before the isSameOriginApi early return, which deliberately leaves every other /api/ path to its own HTTP policy. The shim answers; it never writes Cache Storage, so revisioned preview URLs keep the policy that branch protects.
